C1542.title: aBNBc Token Infinite Minting Vulnerability Incident
C1542.summary: In December 2022, DeFi protocol Ankr published its aBNBc incident report, stating that an attacker obtained a developer private key and uploaded a malicious contract, causing abnormal minting of aBNBc tokens and an estimated loss of about USD 5 million in BNB. Ankr later described its response and compensation arrangements for affected liquidity providers. The case illustrates the impact of private-key compromise and uncontrolled contract-upgrade privileges on DeFi asset security.
